units.summary: Adds the from-selected-series hint to the block meta and keeps the hints list sorted. Calling it more than once has no further effect. The hint is written into meta.json, so it changes what is persisted.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series compaction hint
units.reason: Adds a new value to the persisted block meta.json hints.
focus: Older readers and external tools (e.g. Thanos) seeing an unknown hint in meta.json

units.summary: New predicate that reports whether the block's hints contain from-selected-series. It mirrors FromStaleSeries and is used for hint propagation and for the in-order maxt computation.
units.headline: New predicate checks for the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple read-only check; its effect comes from the callers, which are reviewed separately.

units.summary: New unit test covering the setter and predicate: hint starts absent, setting twice adds it only once, and it can coexist with the stale-series hint. Test-only, so it cannot change production behavior.
units.headline: Test for selected-series hint set and check
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: Write now copies the selected-series hint from the base meta to the new block, the same way it already copies the stale-series hint. This affects which blocks are later excluded from the in-order maxt computation.
units.headline: Compactor Write passes the selected-series hint on to new blocks
units.reason: Changes which hints end up in persisted block metadata.
focus: Whether hints should also be carried over when blocks are merged by Compact (not just Write)

units.summary: Blocks tagged from-selected-series no longer count toward the in-order max time. This changes the in-order watermark, which affects head truncation and compaction decisions.
units.headline: Selected-series blocks excluded from in-order max time
units.reason: Changes the watermark logic that drives compaction.
focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime when every block on disk is a selected-series block

units.summary: New test: a series holding out-of-order data is skipped and stays in the head, while the other series is compacted into a block and removed. Test-only.
units.headline: Test that series with out-of-order data are skipped
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test: rewriting a selected-series block through compactor.Write keeps the from-selected-series hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Test that the selected-series hint survives compactor Write
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test: when the only block on disk is a selected-series block, inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports that no in-order block exists. Test-only.
units.headline: Test that in-order max time ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: New test only.
